$description: Semantic tier, light theme (base). Components consume ONLY these.

page.$description: Warm paper page ground, kept one step duller than any board theme so the board is the brightest object on screen.

raised.$description: Cards, panels, move list. One step brighter than page; elevation without shadows.

sunken.$description: Wells and input grounds. Recedes behind raised content without losing muted-text contrast.

primary.$description: Warm near-black body ink. 14.9:1 on page; survives AAA on all three surfaces.

muted.$description: Secondary labels, timestamps, captions. Held at 7:1+ so "muted" never means "illegible".

on-accent.$description: Text and icons on filled accent controls.

inverse.$description: Text on ink-colored fills such as the black half of the evaluation bar.

default.$description: Single action accent. Warm without drifting into saffron; never placed adjacent to a green so the pair cannot read as a flag or trip red/green deficiency.

hover.$description: Hover/pressed step of the action accent; keeps 4.5:1 with on-accent text.

link.$description: Inline links share the action hue; underline is the mandatory second channel.

info.$description: Informational role: coach notes, progress annotations. Chosen as the accent’s opposite under deuteranopia/protanopia simulation.

success.$description: Correct puzzle result, accuracy gains. Always paired with a check icon — hue is never the only channel.

danger.$description: Errors, blunder flags, destructive actions. Rose-leaning red so it separates from the terracotta accent; always paired with an icon or label.

subtle.$description: Hairlines and dividers; decorative, so exempt from the 3:1 non-text rule.

strong.$description: Control boundaries (inputs, checkboxes). Held at 3:1+ against page per WCAG 1.4.11.

ring.$description: Focus indicator. 3:1+ against page and distinct from the action accent so focus never reads as selection.

white-advantage.$description: White’s half of the evaluation bar. Neutral, not green — direction is carried by the numeric label and the bordered midline.

black-advantage.$description: Black’s half of the evaluation bar.

track-border.$description: Bar outline; keeps the bar legible against page regardless of which side dominates.
